item.title: Top 5 Methods to Compile a Visual Studio Project from the Command Line
item.description:
In the world of software development, particularly when working with C++ using Visual Studio, it’s often necessary to automate the build process without engaging the GUI. This is particularly useful in continuous integration and deployment scenarios. Here, we will explore five effective methods to compile your Visual Studio projects directly from the command line using different tools like MSBuild and DevEnv.
